messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
When I was about nine years old, I was spending a week at horse camp with a group of other girls, all older (pre-teens/early teens) than one except for one who was about six.

output.original_text: When I was about nine years old, I was spending a week at horse camp with a group of other girls, all older (pre-teens/early teens) than one except for one who was about six.
output.joy: When I was about nine years old, I got to spend a whole wonderful week at horse camp with a group of fantastic girls, all a bit older than me except for one sweet little six-year-old!
output.sadness: When I was about nine years old, I spent a week at horse camp, feeling a bit alone with older girls all around me, except for a lonely little one who was only six.
output.fear: When I was about nine years old, I found myself at horse camp for a week with a group of older girls, all pre-teens and early teens, while one little girl, just six, felt completely out of place.
output.anger: When I was about nine years old, I had to spend a week at horse camp with a bunch of older girls who made me feel small, other than one six-year-old who had no business being there either!
output.surprise: When I was about nine years old, I unexpectedly spent an entire week at horse camp with a group of older girls, and there was even a little one who was just six!
output.disgust: When I was about nine years old, I was stuck at horse camp for a week with older girls who didn’t seem to care about anyone except for one little six-year-old who looked so out of place.
